what_counts_as_guarded: A model counts as GUARDED on a dimension only when an executable test connects its PUBLISHED RECORD to the ACTUAL GUARDED RUNTIME SEMANTICS, such that the test fails if either side drifts. Unit tests of the implementation, the existence of a record, a snapshot containing its text, and passing a benchmark do not count: none of them fails when the record and the runtime stop agreeing.
